about: Chases an enemy lord or army while it is in view, and searches where it was last seen when it is not. Weigh the two paces first: a target faster than the hunter is reached only when it stops (to besiege, raid, fight or go into a holding) or turns toward the hunter, so chasing it can tie the hunter up for days and take it from other work. Set a faster target's hunt only when the hunter has nothing better to do, or to keep the target away from a place or a lord it threatens.
calls_back: contact is lost, the target is gone, or it joins a force too strong to attack

lose_hours: give up when the target has not been seen for this many hours
bigger_ratio: stop when the target, with the lords near it and the host it marches with or to join, grows to this many times its strength

when.poke: {target} is gone (beaten, captured or broken up).
{target} is now too strong for {me} to attack: with the lords near it and the host it marches with, strength {company(target)} against {strength}.

search.about: searching for {target} where it was last seen

when.poke: {target} is gone (beaten, captured or broken up).
